final.role: Lightweight Elasticsearch-compatible full-text search engine (Go, single binary, built on bluge) with web UI and ES ingestion API
final.evidence: Full text indexing; single binary with releases for multiple platforms; CI runs go test on Linux/macOS/Windows; hundreds of production installations.

conferencia.nota: Full-text engine over a network service with ES-compatible API; viable candidate for the search layer, though no MCP and no Portuguese mention.
